messages:
sara: pushed a tiny sandbox change: console lets admins adjust feature-flag cache TTLs. wanted to flag for safety/telemetry review before prod enable

miguel: who has permission and does it touch active snapshots or future ones only?

sara: admin-only. UI offers two toggles: 'apply to future snapshots' (default safer) or 'apply immediately to active snapshots'. plan is to default to future.

tarun: telemetry: emit 'flag.ttl.updated' with flag_id, old/new, actor, trace_id. add metric 'flag.ttl.update.count' and a derived 'cache.prefix_hit_rate_by_flag'.

emily-dx: UX: show 7d sparkline for hit-rate + avg latency next to editor and require confirmation checkbox "I understand this affects cache behavior". also timeline entries for audits.

jess-runbooks: runbook: if hit-rate increases >12% vs baseline in 5m, revert TTL to previous value and clear affected prefixes, then notify owner + oncall. can ops-bot make a revert suggestion?

ops-bot: created ticket #7001 "ttl-regression-revert-suggest" with revert checklist. (automated) :white_check_mark:

miguel: API: require optimistic locking on PATCH via If-Match ETag and return 412 on mismatch. include recent_deploy_id if deploy in last 20m in event payload so we can correlate.

sara: will implement: default future-only, telemetry event + counter, sparkline + checkbox + timeline, optimistic locking, sampling header x-flag-ttl for 1/1000 requests, and wire basic alert prototype. i'll push to staging tomorrow and ask for a 15m smoke check.

emily-dx: add a small rollback button in UI that pre-fills prior TTL and offers to clear cache.

jess-runbooks: i'll draft the notification templates and rollback steps now.

sara: thanks team 64f. staging link when ready and i'll ping for the quick-check.
